# rwx_vault (Resource)

Manages an RWX vault. Learn more about [vaults](https://www.rwx.com/docs/vaults).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rwx_vault" "example" {
  name               = "example"
  unlocked           = false
  approvals_enabled  = true
  required_approvals = 2

  repository_permissions = [{
    repository_slug = "rwx-cloud/example"
    branch_pattern  = "main"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the vault.

### Optional

- `approvals_enabled` (Boolean) Whether access to the vault requires approval.
- `repository_permissions` (Attributes Set) The repositories and branches that can access the vault. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repository_permissions))
- `required_approvals` (Number) The number of approvals required to access the vault.
- `unlocked` (Boolean) Whether the vault can be accessed without an explicit access grant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stable ID of the vault.
- `oidc_subject` (String) The stable OIDC subject associated with the vault.

<a id="nestedatt--repository_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repository_permissions`

Required:

- `branch_pattern` (String) The branch pattern allowed to access the vault.
- `repository_slug` (String) The repository slug, such as rwx-cloud/cloud.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_vault.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
